assurance.scope: Independent editorial delta review of the frozen 53-report policy corpus. This is not a new full literature review, citation audit, experiment audit, or source-freshening pass.

method.baselineComparison: Read baseline bytes from git commit 777f49a036bee51c2bc704db65c684d830311408 and current bytes from the worktree; recomputed all 53 baseline and final SHA-256 values independently.
method.semanticReview: Read all 234 changed prose/comment blocks in baseline/current pairs with adjacent report context. Checked scope, attribution, uncertainty, protocol caveats, negative evidence, and concreteness.
method.protectedContent: Verified the author ledger reconstructs each complete file diff. Compared non-comment frontmatter, source metadata, heading sequences, formulas, pipe-table lines, raw URLs, Markdown destinations, image lines, the complete official-figure section, numeric-token sequences, trailing newline, and trailing whitespace.
method.sourceEscalation: No primary source was reopened because the two findings are directly established by baseline/current wording and unchanged local evidence. No new factual claim is made from external lookup.
method.citationAuditSemantics: Applied context-appropriateness and attribution discipline from citation-audit. Did not claim existence or metadata re-verification, and did not emit a full CITATION_AUDIT artifact.
method.productionBoundary: No production report was edited; no email, push, deployment, or other external action was performed.

selfCorrectionReview.assessment: The repaired gate sentence states the observable minimum-write implication and leaves bad-message rejection uncertain. It no longer asserts that the complete system cannot reject messages.
The repaired sentence explicitly marks 2 s to 4 s as an example while the next unchanged sentence preserves the different history inputs used by other models.

substantiveFindings.baselineMeaning: ECO provides no hard safety guarantee.
substantiveFindings.currentText: 其软约束仍需独立安全层配合。
substantiveFindings.assessment: “仍需”把原报告和正文的“可能仍需”提升为无条件部署要求。现有文本只支持缺少硬安全保证，以及独立安全层可能仍然必要。
substantiveFindings.requestedRewrite: 其软约束不构成硬安全保证，部署时可能仍需独立安全层配合。

substantiveFindings.baselineMeaning: Improved multi-view understanding was explicitly labeled as the authors claim; the report itself only accepted evidence for offline trajectory generation.
substantiveFindings.currentText: 论文通过语义对齐改善多视角理解，现有实验直接支持额外视觉与文本监督对离线轨迹生成的帮助。
substantiveFindings.assessment: 第一分句把作者的机制主张改写为既成结果；报告中的消融直接测量 L2 轨迹误差，而非独立的“多视角理解”指标。第二分句的证据边界是合适的。
substantiveFindings.requestedRewrite: 论文以语义对齐整合双视角与文本；现有消融直接支持额外视觉与文本监督对离线轨迹生成的帮助。
